title: Observable-controlled pruning and refit of native ZAFF4 couplings
summary: Inspect every native mixed coupling, remove redundant or insignificant complete terms, refit retained coefficients and reject reductions failing any available observable or the reference E/G/H gate.
gates: Cover every mapped mixed native coupling; the frozen nonbonded field is unchanged
Significance is the normalized contribution to declared observables, never a raw coefficient cutoff
Unobserved couplings are protected rather than assumed insignificant
Remove complete terms or prelinked symmetry groups including defining-bond switches
Bound cumulative fixed-coefficient removals, refit retained coefficients and reevaluate every training and independent validation row
Preserve reference E/G/H to 1e-9 atomic units; reject failed reduction and retain the original artifact
Finite-observable compression does not certify global potential, spectrum or Golden Rule rate
coordinate_policy: Retain frozen native primitive identity and symmetry-linked column definitions across training, validation and output.
backend_policy: Declared remote host, 128 GiB process limit and worker budget. New quantum controls use LINK/GDV with 128 GB each. Reference consolidation: architect-zaff-hierarchy.v7 preserves the canonical parent forms; native PIC candidates require independent qualification.
